statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
Diagnosis codes G45.9, R42, and Z86.73 were billed
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The service was rejected because coverage may be available through another insurer pursuant to coordination of benefits protocols
The concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia is a potential etiology for transient cerebral ischemic events
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities
